description: eprun is a Python package published by the stevenkfirth repository for running and analysing EnergyPlus building simulations. It creates or modifies IDF, epJSON and EPW inputs, launches simulation runs and reads output files including end, error and ESO results. The README demonstrates a single-zone model, extracts hourly output summaries and plots zone air temperature. Source and example notebooks are public on GitHub and free under MIT. Geographic coverage and weather period depend on the supplied building and EPW file; reporting resolution is set by the EnergyPlus run, not fixed by this package. Users can script repeated runs for parametric analysis and connect results to pandas and matplotlib. A limitation is that the wrapper requires a separate compatible EnergyPlus installation and valid model inputs. The demonstration is evidence of documented use, not proof that a user's building model is calibrated. eprun supports repeatable building-energy workflows around the catalogue's EnergyPlus engine (model-energyplus), whose calculations it invokes. No local software installation or simulation execution was performed for this review.
